results.title: The Unknowing of Things
results.overview: The ten-minute Pragmatognossia plays with the letters of the Greek alphabet, through the voice of a small child who is coming out into the world for the first time. Old photographs, worn documents, faded seals, handwritten notes, tax registers, invoices, stamps, ... cracks in time but also little flames that keep the entire memory of the state alive, frame by frame".

results.title: Searching 4 Saturn
results.overview: Set against Alabama A&M’s Homecoming Week, Searching 4 Saturn follows poet and scholar Joshua Baker as they muse on southern inheritance across time and space. The film asks what it means to be Black and Queer in a state caught between cycles of oppression and resistance.

results.title: >1,5°C Pyropolitics and the New World
results.overview: The devastating forest fires in Los Angeles are described in three acts.

results.title: Nachtcafé
results.overview: People seeking shelter during winter in Cologne enter a church. In the darkness, a voice arises. Gradually, a picture emerges of a city marked by those who transit it, but often go unseen.

results.title: The Lost Ones
results.overview: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

results.title: Overseas
results.overview: When Clarissa, a young copy editor, realizes that her father is destined to disappear, she proposes they complete an old, unfinished short story in an attempt to preserve his presence and legacy through the written word.

results.title: Drive - The Pretenders
results.overview: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

results.title: Gasp
results.overview: A night of horror movies among friends turns into a real nightmare when a masked killer enters the scene. But nothing is what it seems—and the game of death has only just begun.

results.title: Rancho Mirage
results.overview: To avoid being put in memory care by his son, a man with Alzheimer's runs away to visit his deceased brother in Las Vegas.

results.title: Dear Nanni
results.overview: What if the only way to face life was to escape into cinema? Thirty years after Caro Diario, filmmaker Pablo Maqueda leaves Madrid on a Vespa, chasing the sun of Moretti’s Italy. With eight friends by his side, he embarks on a journey where laughter, memory, and film intertwine. As reels roll and roads unfold, reality gently fades – and what begins as a tribute becomes a meditation on how cinema doesn’t just reftect life, but transforms it.

results.title: Body Electric
results.overview: A rework of the new iPhone 15 commercial featuring a singing wall socket. In place of the machine loneliness of the original, a different song from the early Vito Acconci playbook. A direct address to the viewer/listener from a virtual assistant. The new ambient intelligence promises security, rapid response, predictive analysis, microgeneration, efficiency. Here it delivers funwashing messages from the cloud for users in a performative essay on domotics. Talk back from the data harvest and Orwell’s “never sleeping ear.” To challenge them is to “fight the future.”

results.title: Escaping Idi Amin
results.overview: A brutal dictator orders 80,000 people to leave the country within 90 days or face the consequences. Many have British passports. As the deadline looms, will Britain help?

results.title: DEAD or ALIVE
results.overview: An outlaw is confronted by a bounty hunter and read off his crimes

results.title: Eat My Cookie!
results.overview: Two brosphere vloggers invite previous channel og Hayden for a special camping reunion episode, but sanctity of boys trip is threatened when he brings his girlfriend. Together they'll discover what happens when you give a bro a cookie.

results.title: Untasted
results.overview: Zad, an alien foodie from the Cluster of Raa, brings his family to prehistoric Earth on a quest to taste something no Raaian has tasted before. But when his daughter forms a strange connection with a human cave child, it puts a dent in Zad’s plans for dinner.

results.title: The Core
results.overview: The story follows an elderly truth-seeker at the end of his life who stands near an abyss and is visited by metaphysical entities offering order and salvation.

results.title: Where The Tree Stands
results.overview: A teenager haunted by the lingering shadow of a conflict with a friend that took place years ago. Each of them has their own hidden struggles until one of their friends tries to bring back the memories and the atmosphere of the past.

results.title: No More Candy
results.overview: Felissa Rose (SLEEPAWAY CAMP, VICTOR CROWLEY) faces a dilemma as Siri and Alexa face off on Halloween night in ArieScope's 28th annual Halloween short film.

results.title: My Friend the Dandelion
results.overview: When a young girl wishes on a dandelion for a friend, a magical lion appears. Together they navigate new friendships and how to say goodbye.  "Nothing lasts forever so enjoy the time you have"
